title: Deterministic Dynamic KV Tiering Scheduler

llama_cpp_verification.reconstruction_method: git -C third_party/llama.cpp stash push -u; verify clean at pinned_commit; reapply the 4 patches above in order; git diff; compare byte-for-byte against the pre-stash working-tree diff; git checkout -- . && git stash pop to restore
llama_cpp_verification.note: Phase 12F introduced no new patch and made no edits under third_party/llama.cpp -- the dirty working tree carries only the cumulative effect of the 4 patches already established and committed in Phases 12B-12E. This was manually verified once (see method above); scripts/verify-results.py's Phase 12F check recomputes the cheap, read-only half of this (dirty-file-set equals the union of files touched by the 4 patch files on disk) on every run.

policy_type: deterministic, config-driven, decode-index-triggered -- no ML/adaptive/learned-hotness component

artifacts.scheduler_config.json: Section 4: config schema + values used across experiments

artifacts.decision_trace.jsonl: Section 26: raw per-transition decision trace from the first schedule
artifacts.vram_timeseries.json: Section 8: VRAM samples across the first schedule's 15 decodes
artifacts.stability.json: Section 10: 56-relocation repeated cycle, no VRAM growth
artifacts.hotset_sweep.json: Section 13: static split sweep 0/8/15/22/30 of 30 layers
artifacts.promotion_group_sweep.json: Section 14: group-size 1/2/4/8 promote+demote latency and VRAM delta
artifacts.frequency_sweep.json: Section 15: schedule interval 1/4/16/64 decodes, relocation overhead %
artifacts.pressure_test.json: Section 16: pressure-regime run, ctx scaled to 65536 (documented deviation)
artifacts.q5.json: Section 20: Q5_1 precision schedule + promotion latency
artifacts.policy_comparison.json: Section 24: static vs dynamic policy comparison
artifacts.pareto.json: Section 25: VRAM/throughput Pareto points from hotset sweep
artifacts.failure_cases.json: Section 27: enumerated failure-handling cases and verdicts
artifacts.determinism.json: Section 28: identical planning trace across two independent runs
